categories.main_business_segments: Akeso, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of innovative antibody drugs, primarily in oncology, autoimmune, and metabolic diseases. The company operates an end-to-end drug development platform and has a portfolio of over 50 innovative programs, including bi-specific antibodies, ADCs, and monoclonal antibodies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes its proprietary ACE Platform for integrated drug discovery and development, including target validation, antibody drug discovery, CMC production process development, and GMP-compliant manufacturing. It has developed Tetrabody technology to address challenges in bi-specific antibody production, and is advancing ADC platforms and bi-specific antibody technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Akeso serves commercial customers and distributors primarily in the biopharmaceutical sector, with a focus on hospitals and medical institutions. Its key markets include oncology and autoimmune/metabolic disease patients, with products included in China's National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL). Major customers include SUMMIT and other distributors across China and globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, with significant clinical and commercial activities also in the United States and other regions. It has subsidiaries and manufacturing facilities in China (Greater Bay Area, Guangzhou, Zhongshan) and Australia, and collaborates globally through partners like SUMMIT for international clinical trials and commercialization.
categories.supply_chain_position: Akeso operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug discovery, clinical development, manufacturing, and commercialization. It controls integrated manufacturing facilities compliant with FDA, EMA, and NMPA standards, supporting both internal and partner product supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in bi-specific antibodies and ADCs, expanding global clinical development especially in immuno-oncology. It focuses on advancing late-stage clinical assets like cadonilimab and ivonescimab, developing novel mechanisms (e.g., CD47, IL-4R/ST2 bispecific antibodies), and expanding non-oncology pipelines in metabolic and autoimmune diseases. R&D investments are increasing to support global trials and new IND applications.
categories.revenue_model: Akeso generates revenue primarily through commercial sales of its biopharmaceutical products and license income from collaboration agreements. Sales are mainly product-based with distribution costs deducted. License income includes upfront payments and milestone payments from partners like SUMMIT. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Akeso positions itself as a leading innovator in China’s biotech industry with a competitive edge in bi-specific antibody drugs and ADCs. It is recognized internationally for clinical trial leadership, especially with ivonescimab outperforming pembrolizumab in NSCLC. The company competes with global and domestic biopharmaceutical firms in oncology and autoimmune therapeutic areas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Akeso reported revenue of approximately RMB2.12 billion, with commercial sales growing 24.88% year-on-year. Despite a net loss of RMB501.1 million due to reduced license income and increased costs, the company has strong cash reserves (over RMB7.3 billion) and expanding manufacturing capacity. It has shown rapid growth since its 2020 IPO, with increasing R&D and commercialization investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Akeso emphasizes affordable, innovative antibody therapies with superior clinical profiles, including first-in-class and best-in-class bi-specific antibodies. Its products address unmet medical needs, such as efficacy in PD-L1 low/negative cancer populations and post-EGFR-TKI resistant NSCLC. The company’s integrated platform and proprietary technologies enable efficient development and manufacturing, supporting global clinical leadership and broad therapeutic coverage.
